Premium portfolio contribution up 35% over two years and growing six times the toothpaste category.
E-commerce and quick commerce now about 10% of business, growing faster and margin-accretive.
Cash generated ₹1,806 Cr in FY26; return on capital employed 121%.
Second interim dividend declared, taking FY26 total to about ₹48 per share, ~100% of NPAT.
Commodity and currency headwinds persist; pricing actions in low single digits are being assessed.
Promotional intensity remains high and is not expected to let up in the short term.

operating_notes.text: Second interim dividend declared at ₹24 per share for FY26.
Premium portfolio contribution up 35% over two years and growing six times the toothpaste category.
E-commerce and quick commerce channel about 10% of business, growing faster and margin-accretive.
GST IDS impact: 80 bps on FY26 EBITDA margin and 160 bps in Q4FY26.
Premium toothpaste is growing 6x the market and now contributes 2.5x its earlier share of toothpaste sales.
Advertising was 15.8% of Q1FY27 sales, with about 60% of spend going to digital and the rest to television.
Working capital ended FY26 at -15% of sales and return on capital employed is 121%.
Q2FY27 gross margin expanded 40 bps YoY to 69.6%, credited to the Funding the Growth programme.
Toothpaste delivered high-single digit volume expansion in Q2FY27, led by the premium range and Colgate MaxFresh.
Advertising was ₹314.82 Cr in Q2FY27, 18.5% of sales, versus 15.8% of Q1FY27 sales.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,595.35 Cr, net profit ₹353.32 Cr (-0.5% YoY).
Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited shared the video recording link for its Q4 FY26 and FY26 analyst conference call held on May 22, 2026, at 05:30 PM (IST).
Colgate-Palmolive India held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, guiding FY27 volume growth to be balanced with pricing and flagging ongoing GST IDS margin impact.

At its Investor Day on 17 August 2026, Colgate-Palmolive India said it would drive growth ahead of profitability, stepping up advertising (Q1FY27 ₹252 Cr, +34% YoY) behind a premium portfolio growing 6x the market.
Colgate Palmolive (India) Limited’s Board declared Rs. 24 interim dividend per share, payable from November 19, 2026, to shareholders as of November 2, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,705.79 Cr, net profit ₹341.57 Cr (+4.3% YoY).
Colgate-Palmolive issued postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for appointing Manish Anandani as MD & CEO for 5 years.
